tasks.description: Remove the dist/ output directory so the next build starts from a clean slate.
Compile TypeScript sources to JavaScript using the project's tsconfig.
Run Biome linting and formatting checks across the repo.
Type-check the project with tsgo without emitting output.
Detect unused exports and dead code with fallow.
Run the full Vitest suite once (unit + E2E) in non-watch mode.
Bundle the compiled entry point into a single dist/bundle.js via esbuild.
Auto-fix lint and formatting issues in place with Biome.

tags.build: Tasks that produce build artifacts (clean, compile, bundle).
tags.test: Quality gates run in CI: linting, type-checking, dead-code detection, and tests.
